seo_title: How to start selling online without a website or perfect setup
seo_description: Your first customers already know you - friends, family, that coworker who comments on everything. Start with 10 listings and one platform, not a perfect website. Learn more on my blog. #sellingonline #ecommercetips #smallbusinesstips

pin_items.title: SKIP THE PERFECT SETUP
pin_items.description: You don't need a custom website, professional photos, or an llc to make your first sale.

pin_items.title: PICK ONE PLATFORM
pin_items.description: Etsy for handmade, Facebook marketplace for local, amazon for products with existing search demand.

pin_items.title: YOUR NETWORK IS YOUR FIRST MARKET
pin_items.description: Your first 10 sales come from people who already know you, not strangers finding you through search.

pin_items.title: LIST BEFORE YOU'RE READY
pin_items.description: The businesses that succeed are the ones that started selling before everything felt perfect.

seo_title: Why most people never start selling online and how to actually do it
seo_description: Months of researching platforms, comparing payment processors, watching tutorials - and never selling anything. Here's the sequence that actually works. The full breakdown is on my blog - go check it out. #howtosellonline #ecommerce #onlinebusiness
image_headline: Why you're stuck before you start
cta: The full breakdown is on my blog - go check it out.

pin_items.title: THE RESEARCH TRAP
pin_items.description: Most people spend months comparing platforms and never actually list anything for sale.

pin_items.title: YOU DON'T NEED ALL OF IT
pin_items.description: Custom website, professional photography, llc, logo, full inventory - none of that comes first.

pin_items.title: THE REAL FIRST STEP
pin_items.description: List 10 items with clear photos and honest descriptions on one platform that matches your product.

pin_items.title: SELL TO SOMEONE YOU KNOW
pin_items.description: Your first sale should be to someone in your network, not a stranger from search.

seo_title: How to get your first 10 sales online without ads or waiting for search traffic
seo_description: Your first reviews, your shipping process figured out, real feedback on your product - all from 10 sales to people who already know you. Get more info on my blog. #sellingonline #firstsale #smallbusiness
cta: Get more info on my blog.

pin_items.title: WEEK 1: ANNOUNCE IT
pin_items.description: Post on personal social media that you're launching - the people who care about you want to support you.

pin_items.title: WEEK 2: SOFT LAUNCH
pin_items.description: Offer to 5-10 close contacts at a small discount in exchange for honest feedback and a review.

pin_items.title: WEEK 3: GO PUBLIC
pin_items.description: Open your shop officially and ask early customers to leave reviews - they're worth more than your first dollars.

pin_items.title: WEEKS 4-8: STAY VISIBLE
pin_items.description: Post regularly about products, process, behind-the-scenes, and customer photos.

seo_title: Etsy vs amazon vs Shopify - which platform to start selling on first
seo_description: The right platform depends on what you're selling, not which one sounds best. Here's how to match your product to the platform that makes sense. Learn more on my blog. #etsyvsshopify #ecommerceplatform #sellingonline

pin_items.title: ETSY
pin_items.description: Best for handmade, vintage 20+ years, and creative supplies - built-in traffic finds you.

pin_items.title: AMAZON
pin_items.description: Best for products with existing search demand where people already know what they want.

pin_items.title: FACEBOOK MARKETPLACE
pin_items.description: Best for local sales and testing whether something sells before investing in shipping.

pin_items.title: SHOPIFY
pin_items.description: Best when you want full brand control - but you drive your own traffic.

pin_items.title: THE RULE
pin_items.description: Pick one platform, get your first 50 sales, then consider adding a second channel.

seo_title: From zero sales to your first customers - the online selling path that works
seo_description: The sellers who succeed aren't the ones with the best tech or prettiest branding. They're the ones who started before they felt ready and learned from their first 10 customers. #startsellingonline #ecommercebeginner #onlineselling

pin_items.title: THE 3 PRODUCT TESTS
pin_items.description: Can you ship it affordably, price it at 3-4x your landed cost, and are people actually searching for it?

pin_items.title: PHOTOS THAT CONVERT
pin_items.description: One product-only shot, one scale reference, detail closeups, and one lifestyle shot - smartphone is fine.

pin_items.title: PRICING WITH ROOM TO BREATHE
pin_items.description: If your landed cost is $15, you need to sell at $45-60 for a sustainable business.

pin_items.title: YOUR FIRST SALE IS CLOSER THAN YOU THINK
pin_items.description: But only if you actually list something - the perfect moment doesn't exist, this one does.
